items.s: The First Session of the Lok Sabha commenced on which of the following dates?
items.x: The first Lok Sabha was constituted on 17 April 1952 and its first session commenced on 13 May 1952; option 4 (18 May 1952) is evidently a misprint of that date, and the other dates are wrong.

items.src: AP Grama Ward Sachivalayam Ward Planning & Regulation Secret
items.s: The concept of Public Interest Litigation (PIL) emerged for the first time in India in which of the following cases ?
items.x: The seeds of PIL were sown by Justice V.R. Krishna Iyer in Mumbai Kamgar Sabha v. Abdul Bhai (1976); PIL took shape in the early 1980s (Hussainara Khatoon 1979, S.P. Gupta 1981). Unnikrishnan (1993), Sarala Mudgal (1995) and L. Chandra Kumar (1997) came much later.

items.s: Which High Court passed orders on April 31, 2004 barring undertrials and absconders from contesting elections?
items.x: The Patna HC (30 April 2004) barred persons in jail or police custody from contesting elections; the SC upheld it in 2013.

items.s: As of July 2023, KK Venugopal is heading which of the following constitutional bodies in India?
items.x:
Most keys: Attorney General (K.K. Venugopal). Strictly, in July 2023 Venugopal no longer held any of these offices – R. Venkataramani was AG from 1 Oct 2022; also the AG is a constitutional office, not a 'body'.
Venugopal's term ended on 30 Sep 2022 — now R. Venkataramani is AG (from 1 Oct 2022, extended Oct 2025) (PIB / lawmin.gov.in)
K.K. Venugopal headed the office of the Attorney General of India (1 Jul 2017 – 30 Sep 2022); the other offices were never his. (now R. Venkataramani, AG since 1 Oct 2022)

items.s: The National Institute for the Mentally Handicapped is situated at –
items.x: The National Institute for the Mentally Handicapped is at Secunderabad (Hyderabad); it is now NIEPID.

items.s: In the case of National Legal Services Authority Vs Union of India, Supreme court gave formal recognition to transgender as "third gender" and placed them in which of the following categories for the purpose of reservation in education and employment?
items.x: NALSA v. Union of India (2014) recognised transgender persons as the third gender and directed that they be treated as socially and educationally backward classes for reservation; option C (worded 'Socially and Economically') is the only option for that category. (Transgender rights; moved.)

items.s: Which one of the following statements is correct? International Relations PMF IAS Misc – 87
o: Kacchativu and Tin Bigha were territories acquired by the Indian Republic from the French
Kacchativu and Tin Bigha are territories handed over to Sri Lankan and Bangladeshi sovereignty respectively by the
Kacchativu and Tin Bigha are areas that were annexed by the Chinese in the 1962 Sino-Indian War
Kacchativu and Tin Bigha are enclaves which were transferred to India by lease arrangements with Sri Lanka and
items.x: Kachchativu was ceded to Sri Lanka in 1974 and the Tin Bigha corridor was given to Bangladesh (perpetual lease, 1992) – option 2; they were not French territories, Chinese-annexed areas or leased to India.

items.s: Who is renowned as ‘Gandhi of Africa’?
items.x:
Most books and keys: Nelson Mandela. Strictly the title 'African Gandhi' is most often given to Kenneth Kaunda of Zambia (search results on Kaunda's obituaries, 2021).
Of the options, Nelson Mandela, who led South Africa's struggle against apartheid, is the one called the 'Gandhi of Africa'.

items.s: The World Bank was established in :
items.x: The World Bank (IBRD) was conceived at Bretton Woods in 1944 with the IMF and formally established in December 1945.
